*Assempix* decodes COFDMTV encoded audio signals to images and is based on open-source software.
COFDMTV is based on COFDM (coded orthogonal frequency-division multiplexing) technology:
- 160 ms long OFDM symbols
- 6.25 Hz per sub-carrier
- 1/8 guard interval
- differentially encoded PSK (phase-shift keying) modulation
- systematic polar codes for forward error correction
Following modes are supported:
Using SPC(64800, 43072):
Mode 6: 8PSK, 2700 Hz BW and about 10 seconds long
Mode 7: 8PSK, 2500 Hz BW and about 11 seconds long
Mode 8: QPSK, 2500 Hz BW and about 16 seconds long
Mode 9: QPSK, 2250 Hz BW and about 18 seconds long
Using SPC(64512, 43072):
Mode 10: 8PSK, 3200 Hz BW and about 9 seconds long
Mode 11: 8PSK, 2400 Hz BW and about 11 seconds long
Mode 12: QPSK, 2400 Hz BW and about 16 seconds long
Mode 13: QPSK, 1600 Hz BW and about 24 seconds long
Payload must be smaller or equal to 5380 bytes.
JPEG, PNG and WebP image formats are supported.
Width and height are limited to between 16 and 1024 pixels.

fdroid:com.ispindle.plotter.name: iSpindle Plotter
fdroid:com.ispindle.plotter.summary: Collect and plot fermentation data from an iSpindel hydrometer.
fdroid:com.ispindle.plotter.description:
iSpindle Plotter is a self-hosted companion app for the iSpindel — an open-hardware floating hydrometer used by home brewers to track specific gravity through a fermentation. The app runs a small HTTP server on your phone that the iSpindel posts its readings to over your local Wi-Fi network, then stores, charts, and analyses those readings without ever sending your data to a third-party cloud service.
Pairing and configuration:
* Auto-pair flow that joins the iSpindel's configuration access point, sets the phone as the HTTP target (Generic HTTP / selAPI=3), reads the device's existing cubic calibration polynomial off the firmware, and reconnects to your home network — without losing pre-existing fields like the calibration on subsequent saves.
* mDNS-style hostname discovery so the iSpindel can find your phone again after either device's IP changes.
* Pushes the app's own calibration polynomial back to the iSpindel when you re-calibrate.
Calibration:
* Fit cubic / quadratic / linear polynomials from your own sucrose-dilution measurements.
* Imports the iSpindel's pre-installed factory calibration on first pairing.
* Setup guide with a sucrose-step-dilution recipe for 1.000–1.080 SG.
Plotting and analysis:
* Tilt angle, temperature, specific gravity, and battery voltage charts with a 24h / 7d / 30d / All time-window switcher.
* Potential-alcohol secondary axis on the SG chart.
* Robust phase classifier (Lag / Active / Slowing / Conditioning / Stuck / Cold crash) using a modified-Gompertz Levenberg-Marquardt fit (Zwietering et al. 1990), with fallback to an attenuation-prior when the data is too early to constrain the asymptote.
* Predicted final gravity overlaid on the chart with a tapering uncertainty band derived from short-time noise estimation and the calibration polynomial's residual.
* Battery runway estimate: linear discharge fit projecting time-to-cutoff at the current sample rate.
* Trim-before-date-and-time to drop pre-fermentation noise; CSV export via the system file picker.
Privacy:
* No analytics, no telemetry, no third-party network connections.
* Data is held only on your phone and only sent to your iSpindel's local IP for configuration writes.
* The app's HTTP server listens on the phone's local network address only.
Hardware: built and tested with an MTB iSpindel PCB 4.0; should work with any iSpindel firmware that supports the Generic HTTP target.

Osmosis is a third-party media client for DJI Osmo action and gimbal cameras. It browses the camera's memory, previews clips, and copies photos and videos to the phone's gallery. It needs no DJI SDK, no account, no activation and no companion service.

* Live camera status: battery, charge state, shooting mode and storage use for internal memory and SD card.
* Multi-camera support: saved cameras are remembered and the list shows which ones are currently in range.
* Mark media as favourite on the camera, and filter the grid to favourites, photos or videos.

Requirements: Android 10 or newer, Bluetooth LE, and permission to use nearby devices (Bluetooth scan and connect) plus Wi-Fi state changes. Location permission is used for Bluetooth scanning on older releases and for the optional GPS sync feature.
Osmosis is an independent project and is not affiliated with, authorized by, or endorsed by DJI. "DJI" and "Osmo" are trademarks of their respective owners.

apple-macos:6794257189.name: Clash - Rule Based Proxy
apple-macos:6794257189.description:
Clash - Rule based proxy utility is now on iOS. 
Clash is a rule-based network proxy utility. Its core builds on the open-source mihomo project and powers the app's NetworkExtension runtime on Apple platforms. The app is built natively with SwiftUI for iPhone and iPad — not a web wrapper and not a port.
Bring your existing Clash or mihomo profile URL. Clash then decides how each connection should be handled: direct, through a selected proxy, or rejected by your rules. Clash ships with no servers and no proxy lines; you supply your own configuration or profile URL.
GETTING STARTED
1. Import — paste a profile URL, scan a QR code, open a YAML configuration, Share one from another app, or start with a blank profile.
2. Choose — refresh policy groups, test latency, and select the route you want.
3. Connect — connect from Home, Control Center, or Shortcuts, then switch routing modes whenever needed.
RULE-BASED ROUTING
• Rule / Global / Direct modes, switched in one tap
• Match domains, suffixes, keywords, IP-CIDR, GEOIP, GEOSITE, ports, network types, and more
• Add custom rules with a visual editor — no YAML by hand
• Update remote rule providers on a schedule
• Every connection shows the rule it matched and the node it took
NODES AND POLICY GROUPS
• select, url-test, fallback, load-balance, and relay policy groups
• Refresh nodes, test latency, and change selections quickly
• Create nodes manually with a field-level editor, configure proxy chains, or use nodes from an imported profile
• Read mihomo-format YAML configurations and remote profiles directly
• Accepts ss / ssr / vmess / vless / trojan / hysteria2 / tuic / anytls share links and Base64 node lists
DNS
• Resolver lists, per-domain policies, Fake-IP and real-IP modes
• DNS over HTTPS, TLS, QUIC, and UDP
• Local DNS mapping: pin a domain to an address you choose, ahead of any resolver
• DNS self-checks, cache controls, and resolution-path diagnostics
A VISIBLE NETWORK
• Live upload and download speed with cumulative traffic
• Current connections, request history, matched rules, and outbound routes
• Runtime logs, core status, and resource usage
• Network quality testing, STUN, and NAT type detection
BUILT FOR IPHONE AND IPAD
• A sidebar with two-column detail on iPad; ⌘1 through ⌘9 jump to the sidebar sections
• Light and Dark Mode, Dynamic Type, and VoiceOver throughout
• Control Center control for one-tap connect
• Shortcuts and Siri actions for connect, disconnect, toggle, and routing mode
• Share extension: send a configuration from any app to import it
• On Demand rules for automatic takeover on selected networks
• Local and iCloud Drive configuration backup and restore
• Localized in English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese
SUPPORTED OUTBOUND PROTOCOLS
HTTP, SOCKS, Shadowsocks, ShadowsocksR, Snell, VMess, VLESS, Trojan, AnyTLS, Mieru, Sudoku, Hysteria, Hysteria2, TUIC, ShadowQUIC, GOST Relay, WireGuard, Tailscale, ZeroTier, SSH, MASQUE, TrustTunnel, OpenVPN
PRIVACY
• No data collected
• No ads, third-party analytics, or tracking SDKs
• Configurations and credentials use iOS Data Protection; optional backups use your own Apple/iCloud account.
• Logs and diagnostics stay local unless you choose to share them.
• Network traffic flows only between your device and the services you configure
OPEN-SOURCE CORE
The Clash core source is public for audit. Issues are welcome. The core is built on the open-source mihomo project.
To connect, you need a Clash or mihomo configuration — bring your own, or create and edit one in the app — and a network service you control or are authorized to use.
Clash source: https://github.com/ProjectClash/Clash
Privacy Policy: https://clash.md/privacy
Terms of Use: https://clash.md/terms
Support and Documentation: https://clash.md/

Psychology is the science of mind and behavior. Psychology includes the study of conscious and unconscious phenomena, as well as feeling and thought. It is an academic discipline of immense scope. Psychologists seek an understanding of the emergent properties of brains, and all the variety of phenomena linked to those emergent properties, joining this way the broader neuro-scientific group of researchers. As a social science, it aims to understand individuals and groups by establishing general principles and researching specific cases.
Psychologists explore behavior and mental processes, including perception, cognition, attention, emotion, intelligence, subjective experiences, motivation, brain functioning, and personality. This extends to interaction between people, such as interpersonal relationships, including psychological resilience, family resilience, and other areas. Psychologists of diverse orientations also consider the unconscious mind.[3] Psychologists employ empirical methods to infer causal and correlational relationships between psychosocial variables. In addition, or in opposition, to employing empirical and deductive methods, some—especially clinical and counseling psychologists—at times rely upon symbolic interpretation and other inductive techniques. Psychology has been described as a "hub science" in that medicine tends to draw psychological research via neurology and psychiatry, whereas social sciences most commonly draw directly from sub-disciplines within psychology.

While traditional Garamond cuts make for exquisite reading at book sizes, they appear clumpy and inelegant at larger sizes. The design goal of Cormorant was to distill the aesthetic essence of Garamond, unfetter it from the limitations of metal printing, and allow it to bloom into its natural refined form at high definition. Cormorant is characterized by scandalously small counters, razor-sharp serifs, dangerously smooth curves, and flamboyantly tall accents. While many implementations of Garamond at small optical sizes already exist (including the open-sourced EB Garamond by Georg Duffner), Cormorant aims for the sparsely populated niche of display-size counterparts that exploit the high resolution of contemporary screens and print media to the fullest. Cormorant is made for large sizes; the larger, the better. However, it works well as a text face in high-resolution environments. Cormorant is a native 21st-century typeface making ample use of OpenType technology. Some OpenType features are applied automatically while you type, subtly improving the flow of the text. This includes kerning, standard ligatures, and contextual alternates. Other features are intended to be activated manually by the user, such as discretionary ligatures, stylistic alternates, small capitals, and alternate figure sets. In Cormorant Infant, the letters “a g y” and their derivatives are replaced by gentle schoolbook-style single-storey shapes.

Erlang/OTP provides tools for building a boot script, and rules for setting environment variables, etc., and Mnesia offers an API for creating and modifying the database schema. However, with no convention for when these tools and API functions are called - and by whom - application developers are left having to invent a lot of code and scripts, not to mention meditate over chapters of Erlang/OTP documentation in order to figure out how things fit together. firefox-addons:784722.name: Dark Theme for Google™
firefox-addons:784722.summary: A highly customizable dark theme for Google products (search, images, translate, and contacts)
firefox-addons:784722.description:
"Dark Theme for Google" extension brings a customizable dark theme to some of the Google services such as Google Search and Google Images. The extension supports all localized Google domains.
Extension Preview:
 https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3lan4mQKxBk 
Using this extension you can customize many colors including background and link colors on the options page of the extension if you don't like the default configuration. 
Features:
1. You can define a period for the extension to automatically activate the dark theme
2. You can append your custom CSS rules to the default dark theme from the options page
3. You can ask the extension to automatically follow the system color scheme (turn dark theme on when the preferred color scheme is dark and turn it off when not) (this feature uses the JavaScript's matchMedia method to install a listener for prefers-color-scheme).
Some of the Supported hostnames
1. Google Search ( www.google.com )
2. Google Images ( images.google.com )
3. SSL Google Search ( encrypted.google.com )
The extension also supports localized Google domains like www.google.fr for the Fr version of Google Search.
Please make sure you don't have the Stylish extension with styles installed that might conflict with this add-on.
--
This extension is an independent open-source project and is not related to Google Inc in anyways.

firefox-addons:2939020.name: Gemini Translate Web Pages
firefox-addons:2939020.summary: Gemini Translate is a Firefox extension that brings Google Gemini models directly into your browser for fast, natural translations.
firefox-addons:2939020.description:
Gemini Translate is a Firefox extension that brings Google Gemini models directly into your browser for fast, natural translations.
✨ Key Features
 Full-page translation 
 Translate entire webpages in place, with a progress bar and smooth text replacement.
 Quick text translation 
 Highlight text → click the floating “Translate” button to see a popup with the translation (styled paragraphs for readability).
 Region translation 
 Use shortcut Ctrl+Shift+F or context menu → draw a region on screen to capture and translate like a screenshot tool.
 Customizable output

 Enable model paragraphing & styling for selection/image/crop translations (bold, italic, lists, headings). 
 Adjustable temperature & top-p settings.
🔒 Security & Privacy

 Runs locally in your browser no third-party servers involved .

firefox-addons:2612181.name: Shopping Cart Share For Amazon
firefox-addons:2612181.summary: Shopping Cart Share is the go-to tool for easy online shopping. Our extension lets you compile carts from all Amazon stores and with just one click, you can share this cart and have others import it to their own account or simply save it.
firefox-addons:2612181.description:
Shopping Cart Share is the go-to tool for easy online shopping. Our extension lets you compile carts from all Amazon stores and with just one click, you can share this cart and have others import it to their own account or simply save it for another time. 
Key features:
- Create a single cart across multiple retailers.
- Share your unified cart or individual carts using a unique cart ID.
- Import shared carts from various retailers.
- Save a multi-store cart for later.
- Easy to manage carts and print as needed. 
Shopping Cart Share doesn't execute any purchasing actions on your behalf. Our platform streamlines the transfer of items from the originator's shopping basket to that of the recipient's - the ultimate transaction process (e.g. checkout) must be undertaken by the user themselves. 
Please note, Shopping Cart Share operates as an autonomous entity, with no official endorsements or authorizations from Amazon.
Start shopping smarter and sharing easier today with Shopping Cart Share!

firefox-addons:3013268.name: Axiom Tools
firefox-addons:3013268.summary: Enhance Axiom trading with advanced analytics, wallet tracking, and faster filtering tools.
firefox-addons:3013268.description:
Axiom Tools is a browser extension designed to enhance the trading experience on Axiom by providing additional analytics, improved visibility, and faster decision-making tools.
Built for active Solana traders, it adds lightweight features directly into the Axiom interface to help identify opportunities more efficiently without disrupting your workflow.
Key Features
Wallet activity tracking for better insight into market participants
Token and holder analysis to evaluate distribution and risk
Faster filtering and data visibility while browsing Axiom
Seamless integration with the existing Axiom interface
Why use Axiom Tools
Instead of relying on a single data source, Axiom Tools helps you access more relevant information in one place, making it easier to evaluate trades and react to market activity.
Privacy
Axiom Tools does not collect, store, or transmit personal user data.

apple-itunes:1577283718.description:
MadFit is the app you need to achieve your fitness goals! Get inspired by MadFit’s expert fitness trainers as they guide you through exclusive workout programs designed to deliver results. Combined with a catalogue of nutritious recipes and new mindfulness features, the app will introduce you to a balanced approach to health and fitness that will leave you feeling your best.
Whether you are looking to start your fitness journey or searching for a new challenge, the MadFit App's broad selection of workouts and programs that range from beginner to expert will help you form healthy habits and build your strength.
All members will get exclusive access to the following features:
Personal Trainers At Your Fingertips
•MadFit’s fitness trainers will guide you through your daily workouts providing you with direction on form, inspiration to push your physical limits, and the knowledge essential to improving your mental and physical strength. Enjoy classes from renowned fitness trainer Maddie Lymburner and certified yoga instructor Arianna Elizabeth.
Recipe Section
• Get inspired to spend more time creating nutritious meals with the expansive recipe section. Choose from a catalogue of delicious and nutritious breakfast, mains, snack, and dessert recipes. Filter through them based on your diet type or diet preferences. With new recipes added regularly, you will never get bored of making the same meal twice!
A Collection Of Varied Workouts
• MadFit offers a massive collection of workouts and exercises to suit your own personal goals and abilities. Choose from a variety of workouts varying in length and difficulty level, all guided by our trainers. With activities ranging from structured challenges that focus on building strength to relaxing, stress-free yoga classes, there’s always an option for your choice of workout.
Real-Time Programs and Challenges
• Subscribe to a program or challenge in the real-time section! These specially crafted exercises consist of follow-along workout videos in a focused structure to get you into the habit of exercising daily and are purpose-built to inspire and get results!
Classic Programs
• Choose between MadFit's 4-week Beginner, 8-week Dancer Sculpt and 12-week Full Body programs which are designed to tone your muscles, build your stamina and improve your fitness. Each day of the program will target new muscles and push your body to new lengths. These programs feature visual and audio guides to ensure you are performing all exercises correctly.
Track Your Sleep, Water and Thoughts.
• Use the MadFit App’s specially designed tools to easily track how much sleep and water you are getting each day. By using the in-app journal, you can take a few minutes after each workout to write down your thoughts and feelings, attach pictures and track your progress.
Sync with Apple Music, Health and More
• Sync with Apple music to listen to your favourite songs while exercising. MadFit uses HealthKit to export your activities into the health app to read your heart rate and biometric data to better track your fitness progress. The MadFit App will also sync with your calendar and Siri.
Join our Community
• Tap the community button inside the app and join the exclusive MadFit insider community. Get the latest information, ask questions and get inspired by community members around the world who are using the MadFit App!

apple-macos:6829383754.description:
Turn real objects into 3D models with your iPhone.
Walk around a shoe, a toy, a mug or a wooden bucket — 3D Scan guides you step by step and builds a textured, real-scale 3D model right on your phone. No account, no cloud: your scans stay on your device.
SCAN
• Guided capture with on-screen tips: too close, too dark, moving too fast
• Model built on iPhone in a few minutes
• Real-scale size in centimeters
VIEW AND SHARE
• Rotate the model in 3D or place it in your room with AR
• Share USDZ to iPhone, iPad and Mac
PRO (one-time purchase, iPhone and Mac)
• STL and 3MF for 3D printing — Bambu Studio, PrusaSlicer, OrcaSlicer, Cura
• Print size and automatic flat base so the model stands on the bed
• OBJ with texture for Blender and other 3D editors
• Ruler: measure distances right on the model
• High quality builds with 3D Scan for Mac
3D SCAN FOR MAC
Send your photos from iPhone with AirDrop and build a much more detailed model on your Mac.
Scanning requires an iPhone or iPad with a LiDAR Scanner (Pro models). Works best with matte, textured objects; shiny, transparent and very thin objects are hard to scan.
